content.value_statement: Reviewer comments can be difficult to answer without unsupported claims. This skill creates traceable response packages with risks, placeholders, and author questions.
actual_capabilities: Splits editor and reviewer comments into stable IDs.
Classifies each comment by type, severity, action, and readiness.
Drafts point-by-point response letters with preserved reviewer comments.
Maps claimed changes to manuscript locations or visible placeholders.
Flags missing evidence, statistics, citations, approvals, and line numbers.
Adds Chinese confirmation notes when authors provide Chinese input.
limitations: Requires author-provided facts for experiments, analyses, citations, and manuscript locations.
Does not draft cover letters by default.
Does not make appeal letters the default output.
Cannot verify current journal policies unless the user asks for verification.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Major Revision
use_cases.description: Turn editor and reviewer comments into a response strategy, tracker, draft letter, and missing-input list.

use_cases.title: Audit a Response Draft
use_cases.description: Check an existing rebuttal for missing replies, unsupported claims, weak tone, and traceability gaps.

use_cases.title: Convert Chinese Author Notes
use_cases.description: Transform Chinese revision notes into professional English responses with clear Chinese follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Response
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with reviewer comments and author notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a point-by-point response letter from these reviewer comments and author notes. Keep placeholders for missing facts.

prompt_templates.title: Audit My Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing response letter.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this response draft against the reviewer comments. List missing replies, unsupported claims, tone risks, and required author inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Handle Conflicting Reviewers
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced revision with editor constraints and reviewer conflict.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a response strategy for these conflicting reviewer requests. Prioritize editor instructions and map each response to manuscript changes.

prompt_templates.title: Triage a High-Risk Revision
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced case with missing evidence, statistics, compliance, or appeal-like signals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Triage this revision package before drafting. Identify blocked items, author questions, readiness state, and any appeal-like issues.

output_examples.input: Reviewer asks for an independent validation cohort, but the author only says validation was added.
output_examples.output: The skill marks the item as needs author input and asks for result summary, cohort size, figure location, and manuscript section.

output_examples.input: Two reviewers disagree about whether the abstract should strengthen or soften a causal claim.
output_examples.output: The skill surfaces the conflict, prioritizes editor constraints and study design, then drafts a cautious response with claim softening.

output_examples.input: A Chinese author note says the reviewer misunderstood the method.
output_examples.output: The skill rewrites the stance as a manuscript clarity issue and adds a Chinese note asking for the exact Methods change.

best_practices: Provide reviewer comments, editor instructions, author actions, and manuscript locations together.
Keep missing facts visible until the author supplies exact evidence.
Review the readiness state before using any text in a submission.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for final wording when evidence, locations, or approvals are missing.
Do not remove placeholders before author facts are confirmed.
Do not use the skill to draft an appeal as a normal revision response.

faq.question: Can this skill write a full response letter?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft a point-by-point response when reviewer comments and author actions are supplied.

faq.question: Can it work with Chinese notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It accepts Chinese notes and can draft English responses with Chinese confirmation items.

faq.question: Will it invent missing experiments or line numbers?
faq.answer: No. It flags missing facts and keeps placeholders visible.

faq.question: Can it handle reviewer disagreement?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies conflicts and uses editor instructions, evidence, and scope to choose a response strategy.

faq.question: Does it draft cover letters?
faq.answer: No. Cover letters are outside its default scope.

faq.question: Is it limited to Nature journals?
faq.answer: No. It is optimized for Nature-style revisions but also supports general peer-review response work.
